annotations.text:
BOTANICAL — approved 2026-08-25.

Held against five researched alternatives on the same screen (Jade Workshop, Garden Party, Matcha, Deep Seaweed, Emerald Luxe) and kept.

These exact values are written into factory/feature.md, which is what 300 Design reads. This canvas is the reference; that file is the contract.

ground  #14513A  rich green, never white
well    #0B3526  the photo sits in a dip
raised  #1B6446  the unsure band
line    #2E7C5A  dividers only
verdict #F3FAF2  8.72:1 AAA
body    #DDEADF  7.46:1 AAA
muted   #BCD6C6  5.98 / 4.59 AA on BOTH surfaces
accent  #FFC94A  6.04:1 AA — the one action colour
warn    #FF9478  unsure marker only, never body text

Dark green #0B2E20 on the yellow button: 9.61:1 AAA.

Why yellow and not lime.

Lime and chartreuse read as budget or playful. Yellow, teal and pink are what give energetic contrast against a deep green ground.

Yellow on green is also just what a botanical plate looks like — sunlight through leaves.

Garden Party was the test of the opposite idea: a green accent and no warm colour at all. It lost because the action button then fights the verdict for attention.

Rules held to:

· buttons 999px, cards 2px — not one radius everywhere
· no shadows, no gradients
· accent well under 10% of each screen
· icons drawn, never emoji
· no fake iOS status bar
· hit targets 48–56px
· the three bands read without colour: dot / rule+triangle / nothing
· Hungarian copy, so the 30-char limit is real
